description: This file declares the 'String' utility class within the 'testing::internal' namespace, providing static methods for string manipulation such as cloning C strings, comparing strings with NULL safety, formatting integers, and handling wide strings. It is an internal component of Google Test to support string operations used during testing.

classes.name: testing::internal::String
classes.description: A utility class providing static string manipulation methods, including string cloning, comparison, formatting, and conversions between wide and narrow strings.

methods.name: CloneCString
methods.description: Clones a null-terminated C string, allocating memory with new. Caller must delete[] the returned pointer. Returns NULL if input is NULL.

methods.name: AnsiToUtf16
methods.description: Converts an ANSI string to a UTF-16 wide string on Windows Mobile platforms, allocating with new. Caller is responsible for deleting the result.

methods.name: Utf16ToAnsi
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 wide string to an ANSI string, allocating with new. Caller is responsible for deleting the result.

methods.name: CStringEquals
methods.description: Compares two C strings for content equality, handling NULL pointers safely.

methods.name: ShowWideCString
methods.description: Converts a wide C string to a UTF-8 encoded std::string, returning '(null)' if input is NULL.

methods.name: WideCStringEquals
methods.description: Compares two wide C strings for content equality, with NULL safety.

methods.name: CaseInsensitiveCStringEquals
methods.description: Compares two C strings ignoring case, handling NULL pointers.

methods.name: CaseInsensitiveWideCStringEquals
methods.description: Compares two wide C strings ignoring case, handling NULL pointers.

methods.name: EndsWithCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if a given string ends with a specified suffix, ignoring case.

methods.name: FormatIntWidth2
methods.description: Formats an integer as a two-digit string with leading zeros, e.g., '03'.

methods.name: FormatIntWidthN
methods.description: Formats an integer with leading zeros to a specified width.

methods.name: FormatHexInt
methods.description: Formats an integer as an uppercase hexadecimal string.

methods.name: FormatHexUInt32
methods.description: Formats a 32-bit unsigned integer as uppercase hexadecimal.

methods.name: FormatByte
methods.description: Formats a byte (unsigned char) as a two-digit uppercase hexadecimal string.

methods.name: StringStreamToString
methods.description: Converts the contents of a stringstream to an std::string, replacing null characters with '\0'.
